description: Verify that Client-mode deactivate — DUT emits StopSubscribeEventgroup for ets3
approach:
[Objective]
Client-mode lifecycle: deactivating a subscription must produce a StopSubscribe SD entry (TTL=0) so the server stops sending events.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester (UT) → DUT: subscribe to ets3 → DUT emits Subscribe.
3. Tester (UT) → DUT: deactivate ets3.
4. Observation: DUT → Tester: StopSubscribeEventgroup (TTL=0).

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT emitted StopSubscribe for ets3 — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_subscribe: No DUT Subscribe for ets3 within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase3_no_stop_subscribe: No DUT StopSubscribe for ets3 within listen window
